reply_text:
The quoted words are on the page exactly, but the candidate fails part 1 of the rule, so it's **out**.

**1. Page check.** The page opened. It is a Marsbit (火星财经) article dated 2023-03-17, by 赵晓晓, republished from 创业邦 (cyzone.cn/article/718380). The quoted sentence is there word for word, including the spacing in "未来 2-3年": "基础大模型需要超级巨量数据和超级算力，未来 2-3年，只要全世界的数据能储存起来，一定有科研机构会突破，做出来最伟大的基础模型。" The page dates the talk to the morning of 14 March (2023 from context), at Lee's first media meeting of the year. It presents the text as "李开复的现场演讲" (his live speech). Even so, it is a news write-up, edited into the first person and republished, not a transcript or his own post. If it had been admitted, it would have been "coverage only".

**2. The admission rule.**
- **Part 1 (role): fails.** The page names his role that day as "创新工场董事长兼首席执行官、创新工场人工智能工程院院长", that is, chair and chief executive of Sinovation Ventures and head of its AI engineering institute. Sinovation is a venture investor, not a company that builds frontier models or the chips they are trained on. I recall, but did not check, that he announced Project AI 2.0 (later 01.AI) a few days later, around 19 March 2023. The page doesn't mention it. Your role history only says "founder of 01.AI 2023", so it can't settle the exact date. On what the page shows, he had no qualifying role on 14 March.
- **Part 2 (forward-looking, about AI): looks met, but loose.** It is about AI and looks forward. But "the greatest foundation model" has no clear test, and it comes with a condition ("as long as the world's data can be stored"). If part 1 were ever revisited, this would likely end up `unfalsifiable`.
- **Part 3 (date or span): met.** "未来 2-3年" (the next 2–3 years) is a span. Taking the later end, it runs to March 2026.
- **Part 4 (primary source): coverage only.**

**Already recorded?** No. None of the person's recorded claim files is this claim.

**For the person checking:** if 01.AI or Project AI 2.0 can be shown to have existed, with Lee leading it, before 14 March 2023, part 1 should be looked at again.
